question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 3% per month for 11 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage = 3% × 11 = 33%.

Directly calculate 33% of the principal to get the simple interest.

Simple Interest = 33% of 1200 = (33 × 1200) ÷ 100

Simple Interest = 33 × 12 = 396

**∴ The correct answer is ₹396.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 Start
 P = ₹1200
 11 Months
 SI = ?
 Rate = 3% per month
 Total Rate = 11 × 3% = 33%

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1200

Rate of Interest (R) = 3% per month

Time (T) = 11 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

Since the rate is given per month and the time is given in months, we do not need to convert the time into years.

⇒ SI = (1200 × 3 × 11) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 12 × 3 × 11

⇒ SI = 36 × 11

⇒ SI = 396

**∴ The correct answer is ₹396.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount, making it uniform. Compound Interest is calculated on both the principal and the accumulated interest of previous periods.

Rate and Time Consistency

Always ensure the time unit matches the rate unit. If the rate is per annum (p.a.) but time is in months, convert time to years using T = (months ÷ 12).

Total Amount Formula

The total amount at the end of the time period is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P + SI = P[1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].
